verdicts.reason: All rules hold: the jq exit code checks buyer, job and pays_for, frames with no buyer are dropped and counted, status assisted matches the brief, an empty list is valid, and checkRunnable false is honest.

All rules hold: a python3 exit code with a verbatim quote and line locator puts a quote under every group, assisted is the floor of the brief's assisted-to-reliable rating, and zero quotes passes as a result.
All rules hold: jq checks the trailing question mark, a non-empty refuted_if (falsifiable) and no answer key (the block the brief's reliable rating needs), and an empty list is valid.

All rules hold: each fact must be a verbatim quote from saved page text or marked unsupported, digits must sit inside quoted spans (no invented metrics), there must be exactly one objection, prepared must come before meeting, assisted matches the brief, and unsupported or N=0 are valid.

All rules hold: the python3 count needs exactly one frame line that matches the winning id, plus a segment and an objection tied to brief.md, so other frames are excluded; assisted matches the brief, and no winning frame exits 0.

All rules hold: jq checks smallest_action, cap, kill_result and gate, and send and pay are absent tools in the registry, so the gated status does not exceed the brief's assisted-plan, gated-send-and-spend rating, and checkRunnable false is honest.
